bias.en: Bearish · lowest close in a year
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收于一年最低

read.en: MP Materials fell 2.2% on Oct 26 to $37.47, its lowest close in 52 weeks, trading between $37.30 and $38.47. It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($38.58), 10-day ($39.60), 30-day ($44.95), 100-day ($50.53) and 200-day ($55.69). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($42.54), and RSI is 28.5, oversold.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月26日下跌 2.2%，收于 $37.47，为 52 周最低收盘价，盘中区间 $37.30–38.47。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$38.58）、10 日（$39.60）、30 日（$44.95）、100 日（$50.53）和 200 日均线（$55.69）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$42.54），RSI 为 28.5，处于超卖区。

read.en: The close slipped below the $37.57–37.81 lows of Oct 22 and Jul 29, though the $37.11 intraday low of Oct 23 held. Resistance is $37.6–38.6 (those lows, 5-day), then $39.6–40 (10-day) and $42.5–44.5 (SAR, Oct 1 low). Support is $37.1 (52-week low), then $35. A close above $38.6 would target $39.6–40; a close below $37.1 would open $35.

r.en: Oct 22 and Jul 29 lows ($37.57–37.81), now resistance; 5-day average $38.58
